about: Draws a field with a mark at one end or both: a currency symbol, a unit, a glyph, or a control.

align.about: The marks on the middle of the field, and at its start, for a control that runs to several lines.
align.title: Alignment

marks.about: A mark at the start, at the end, and at both. The field reserves room where a mark is, so the typing never runs underneath.
marks.title: Marks

note: 1250.00 for the quarter, less the deposit already paid
title: Input group

uses.about: The two marks a currency symbol and a unit do not cover. A glyph says what the field takes, and a control at the far end acts on what the reader typed. A mark takes no pointer, so a press over the glyph lands in the field, and whatever a caller puts inside a mark takes the pointer back.
uses.title: What a mark is for
